[[File:TFF v2.0 screenshot Base.jpg|thumb|400x400px]]

The '''Base''' is you central huib where you can place defending [[Bots]] and [[Module]]s, and where you can access the [[Raid]] Center, the [[Alliance]] Help and the [[Away Mission|Mobile Command]].

== Nodes ==
There are seven nodes where you can place Bots to defend your Base against other Commanders. Nodes with Bots generate [[Gold]] according to the Bot's star rating and rank. 
*1-Star: 30 minutes
**Rank 1: 35 
**Rank 2: 45 
*2-Star: 4 hours
**Rank 1: 300 
**Rank 2: 350 
**Rank 3: 430 
*3-Star: 6 hours
**Rank 1: 525 
**Rank 2: 586 
**Rank 3: 656 
**Rank 4: 744 
*4-Star: 8 hours
**Rank 1: 900 
**Rank 2: 1,013 
**Rank 3: 1,163 
**Rank 4: 1,313 
**Rank 5: 1,500 
*5-Star: 8 hours
**Rank 1: 1,815
**Rank 2: 2,043
**Rank 3: 2,640
**Rank 4: 3,851
**Rank 5: 6,418
**Rank 6: 11,859
There are four [[Relic]] nodes (2 in v1.0) where you can activate a Relic's boosts by placing it. Some can increase Gold generated by 10%.

== HUD ==

* Top bar
** Base
** Bots
** Inventory
** Alliance
** Crystals
** Store
* Bottom
** Calendar
** Mail
** Global Chat
** Alliance Chat
** Alliance Quests

== In-Game Chat ==
The early days of the Global Chat was certainly... crazy colorful.


''There are two main chat channels within our game: global and alliance.''

''Global Chat: This is the chat room for all players in your region.''

''Alliance Chat: If you are in an alliance, this is the chat room for all active members.''

''To turn on or off your ability to see these channels:''

# ''Tap on the settings cog icon near the upper-left section on the home page.''
# Tap on the CHAT tab.
# Under the CHAT ENABLED section, you will see checkboxes next to the GLOBAL and ALLIANCE fields. A checked off box means that you will be able to view that chat.

=== INVITES ===
''There are two types of invitations you may receive while playing the game: alliance invitations and friend requests.''

''Alliance Invitations: If you are not part of an alliance, having this feature turned on lets alliances looking for members know that you are open to an invitation. You will still have to accept that invitation to join their alliance, however. Having this turned off or being part of an alliance will stop those invitations from coming to you.''

''Friend Requests: In order to accept friend requests from others, you need to have this feature turned on. That does not prevent you from sending your own friend requests, however. Having this feature turned off prevents others from sending you friend requests.''

''To turn on or off your ability to see these invitations:''

# ''Tap on the settings cog icon near the upper-left section on the home page.''
# Tap on the CHAT tab.
# Under the CHAT ENABLED section, you will see checkboxes next to the GLOBAL and ALLIANCE fields. A checked off box means that you will be able to view that chat.

There are two types of invitations you may receive while playing the game: alliance invitations and friend requests.

Alliance Invitations: If you are not part of an alliance, having this feature turned on lets alliances looking for members know that you are open to an invitation. You will still have to accept that invitation to join their alliance, however. Having this turned off or being part of an alliance will stop those invitations from coming to you.

Friend Requests: In order to accept friend requests from others, you need to have this feature turned on. That does not prevent you from sending your own friend requests, however. Having this feature turned off prevents others from sending you friend requests.

To turn on or off your ability to see these invitations:

# Tap on the settings cog icon near the upper-left section on the home page.

# Tap on the CHAT tab.

Under the INVITES section, you will see checkboxes next to the ALLIANCE INVITES ON/OFF and FRIEND REQUESTS ON/OFF sections. A checked off box means that you have turned those features on.

=== BLOCKING PLAYERS ===
If you wish to stop seeing what a specific player is saying, for whatever reason, you can.

In order to block the chat from a player:

# First tap on their Commander icon in whichever chat you see them in.
# From the mini-menu that pops up, select the BLOCK button.

To unblock a player:

# Tap on the BLOCKED USERS button in the CHAT drop-down
# Tap the UNBLOCK button next to their name.
